title: Global-to-local tensor cohomology component isomorphisms
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings with R-algebra structures, let C=A tensor_R B, and let i be an integer. Let S,T be functors from unbounded A-complexes to C-modules with natural B-linear restriction isomorphisms eS,eT to source and target [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. Assume that under these isomorphisms multiplication by a tensor 1 agrees with applying the corresponding cohomology functor to a times the identity of the complex. Let c:S to T be a C-linear natural transformation whose B-restriction, conjugated by eS,eT, is comparison. These are the coefficient-lift equations of [lem-pc-affine-tensor-cohomology-lifts]. Let qprime be a prime ideal of C; let q,pprime,p be its contractions to A,B,R. Let Rp,Aq,Bp,D be any models of localization of R,A,B,C at p,q,pprime,qprime respectively. The maps R to Aq and Bp are the composites through A and B, and the maps Rp to Aq and Bp extend them. The maps A to D and B to D are the composites of the tensor inclusions with C to D. The maps Aq to D and Bp to D extend these maps. Let f:Aq tensor_Rp Bp to D be a ring homomorphism whose restrictions to Aq and Bp are these structure maps. Let Sl,Tl be functors on Aq-complexes with natural Bp-linear restriction isomorphisms eSl,eTl to the local source and target. Assume the same Aq-generator equations and that a tensor-linear natural transformation cl:Sl to Tl restricts to the local comparison. Then there are componentwise D-linear isomorphisms alpha and beta, natural in morphisms of A-complexes, with commuting comparison square. Equivalently, S extended along C to D is naturally D-linearly isomorphic, via alpha, to Sl applied after termwise extension from A to Aq and then extended along f. The analogous isomorphism beta exists for T,Tl, and the square with c and cl commutes.

proof.text: Choose the existing balanced derived cohomology models L(M) on the functorial A-K-flat resolution P(M), and K(M) on J(P(M)), where J is extension from A to Aq. K-flatness of J(P(M)) follows from K-flat extension of scalars; exact localization makes J(augmentation_A) a quasi-isomorphism. Apply prescribedTensorCohomology_model_realization globally with U=id,Q=P and locally with U=J,Q=P followed by J. The global coefficient map is flat by localization; the local coefficient map is flat by affineTensorLocalization_flat. These applications supply sigma,gamma and sigmal,gammal with naturality and comparison equations.

Install the local tensor-algebra D-structure from f. The equations hfA,hfB,hB give its scalar towers. The contractions of qprime to R through A agree by IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq and Ideal.comap_comap. Apply derivedTensor_localization_cohomology to L and K to obtain e with its model-map naturality and localized comparison equation.

Tensor associativity gives a natural chain isomorphism tau:D tensor_A P to D tensor_Aq (Aq tensor_A P). The two A-to-D maps agree by the supplied towers. Use ModuleCat.extendScalarsComp and equality of scalar maps to construct tau; its hom sends d tensor x to d tensor (1 tensor x), first for d=1 by extendScalarsComp_hom_app_one_tmul and then for all d by D-linearity. Set alpha=EL(sigma) followed by e followed by ER(sigmal inverse). Set beta=gamma followed by H^i(tau) followed by gammal inverse. For source naturality, apply e naturality to the conjugates sigma inverse S(g) sigma and sigmal inverse Sl(J(g)) sigmal, with the counit-compatible morphisms from realization; cancel the adjacent inverse pairs. For target naturality, compose gamma naturality, H^i of tau naturality, and gammal naturality. For the comparison square, cancel gammal.hom on the right; the global realization equation, e comparison equation, and the local realization equation give exactly the two composites. Every cancellation is between actual isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem affineTensorCohomology_localization_square
    (R A B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (i : ℤ)
    (S T : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B))
      (eS : S ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ≅
        source R A B i)
      (eT : T ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ≅
        target R A B i)
      (c : S ⟶ T)
    (hS : (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (a : A) (x : S.obj M),
        eS.hom.app M ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) a : A ⊗[R] B) • x) =
          (source R A B i).map (a • 𝟙 M) (eS.hom.app M x)))
    (hT : (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (a : A) (x : T.obj M),
        eT.hom.app M ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := R) a : A ⊗[R] B) • x) =
          (target R A B i).map (a • 𝟙 M) (eT.hom.app M x)))
    (hc : Functor.whiskerRight c
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) ≫ eT.hom =
        eS.hom ≫ comparison R A B i)
    (q' : PrimeSpectrum (A ⊗[R] B))
        (Rp Aq Bp D : Type u) [CommRing Rp] [CommRing Aq] [CommRing Bp] [CommRing D]
        [Algebra R Rp] [Algebra A Aq] [Algebra B Bp] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime Rp (q'.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (A ⊗[R] B)))]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime Aq (q'.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime Bp (q'.asIdeal.comap
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom)]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime D q'.asIdeal]
        [Algebra R Aq] [Algebra R Bp] [Algebra Rp Aq] [Algebra Rp Bp]
        [IsScalarTower R A Aq] [IsScalarTower R B Bp]
        [IsScalarTower R Rp Aq] [IsScalarTower R Rp Bp]
        [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D] [Algebra Aq D] [Algebra Bp D]
        [IsScalarTower A (A ⊗[R] B) D]
        [IsScalarTower A Aq D]
        (_hB : ∀ b : B, algebraMap B D b =
          algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b))
        [IsScalarTower B Bp D]
        (f : (Aq ⊗[Rp] Bp) →+* D)
        (_hfA : ∀ a : Aq,
          f (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := Rp) a : Aq ⊗[Rp] Bp) = algebraMap Aq D a)
        (_hfB : ∀ b : Bp, f (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b) = algebraMap Bp D b)
    (Sl Tl : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Aq) ℤ ⥤
            ModuleCat.{u} (Aq ⊗[Rp] Bp))
          (eSl : Sl ⋙
            ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ≅
            source Rp Aq Bp i)
          (eTl : Tl ⋙
            ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ≅
            target Rp Aq Bp i)
          (cl : Sl ⟶ Tl)
    (hSl : (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Aq) ℤ) (a : Aq) (x : Sl.obj M),
            eSl.hom.app M ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := Rp) a : Aq ⊗[Rp] Bp) • x) =
              (source Rp Aq Bp i).map (a • 𝟙 M) (eSl.hom.app M x)))
    (hTl : (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Aq) ℤ) (a : Aq) (x : Tl.obj M),
            eTl.hom.app M ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := Rp) a : Aq ⊗[Rp] Bp) • x) =
              (target Rp Aq Bp i).map (a • 𝟙 M) (eTl.hom.app M x)))
    (hcl : Functor.whiskerRight cl
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom) ≫
              eTl.hom = eSl.hom ≫ comparison Rp Aq Bp i)
    :
    ∃ (alpha : ∀ M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ,
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (S.obj M) ≅
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars f).obj (Sl.obj ((extend A Aq).obj M)))
      (beta : ∀ M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ,
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (T.obj M) ≅
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars f).obj (Tl.obj ((extend A Aq).obj M))),
      (∀ (M N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (g : M ⟶ N),
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map (S.map g) ≫
            (alpha N).hom =
          (alpha M).hom ≫ (ModuleCat.extendScalars f).map
            (Sl.map ((extend A Aq).map g))) ∧
      (∀ (M N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (g : M ⟶ N),
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map (T.map g) ≫
            (beta N).hom =
          (beta M).hom ≫ (ModuleCat.extendScalars f).map
            (Tl.map ((extend A Aq).map g))) ∧
      (∀ M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ,
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).map (c.app M) ≫
            (beta M).hom =
          (alpha M).hom ≫ (ModuleCat.extendScalars f).map
            (cl.app ((extend A Aq).obj M)))
